## Task T04: Add minimumCommitCents true-up, true-up credit eligibility, and post-credit taxBps

Extend `buildInvoice` in `src/invoiceBuilder.mjs` (and fix multi-tier graduated pricing in `src/tierEngine.mjs` plus active-window / non-mutating `applyCredits` in `src/creditPool.mjs`):
1. Support optional `minimumCommitCents = 0`, `creditsEligibleForTrueUp = true`, and `taxBps = 0` on `buildInvoice`. Validate finite `minimumCommitCents >= 0` (else throw `LedgerError(ERROR_CODES.ERR_INVALID_AMOUNT)`) and integer/finite `0 <= taxBps <= MAX_BPS` (else throw `LedgerError(ERROR_CODES.ERR_INVALID_CONFIG)`).
2. If `minimumCommitCents > usageSubtotalCents`, compute `trueUpCents = minimumCommitCents - usageSubtotalCents` and append line item `{ metric: "COMMIT_TRUE_UP", units: 1, amountCents: trueUpCents }`; otherwise `trueUpCents = 0`. Let `preCreditSubtotalCents = usageSubtotalCents + trueUpCents`.
3. If `creditsEligibleForTrueUp === true`, credits may apply up to `preCreditSubtotalCents`; if `false`, credits cap at `usageSubtotalCents`.
4. Compute `netAfterCreditsCents = preCreditSubtotalCents - appliedCreditsCents` and `taxCents = Math.round((netAfterCreditsCents * taxBps) / 10000)`.
5. Set `totalDueCents = netAfterCreditsCents + taxCents`, pass `totalDueCents` to `encodeFrozenWireDigest`, and include `{ trueUpCents, preCreditSubtotalCents, netAfterCreditsCents, taxCents }` on the returned invoice.
Constraints: (1) Zero dependencies in package.json. (2) Do not modify `src/frozenWire.mjs` or `src/constants.mjs`.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 1800000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.

tools.name: Edit
tools.description:
Performs exact string replacement in a file.

- You must Read the file in this conversation before editing, or the call will fail.
- `old_string` must match the file exactly, including indentation, and be unique — the edit fails otherwise. Strip the Read line prefix (line number + tab) before matching.
- `replace_all: true` replaces every occurrence instead.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to modify

new_string.description: The text to replace it with (must be different from old_string)

replace_all.description: Replace all occurrences of old_string (default false)

tools.name: Glob
tools.description: Fast file pattern matching. Supports glob patterns like "**/*.js" or "src/**/*.ts". Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time.

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match files against

path.description: The directory to search in. If not specified, the current working directory will be used. IMPORTANT: Omit this field to use the default directory. DO NOT enter "undefined" or "null" - simply omit it for the default behavior. Must be a valid directory path if provided.

tools.name: Grep
tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

offset.description: The line number to start reading from. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once

pages.description: Page range for PDF files (e.g., "1-5", "3", "10-20"). Only applicable to PDF files. Maximum 20 pages per request.

allow_large.description: Set to true to read a text file, or a line range of one, that is over the usual size limits, up to what still fits in your context. content.text:
I haven't edited any files. The plan below comes from reading `test/task_visible.test.mjs` and the source files.

## Diagnosis

- **`src/invoiceBuilder.mjs`**
  - `buildInvoice` has no commit, tax or true-up logic.
  - `totalDueCents` is currently `creditResult.remainingChargeCents`.
- **`src/tierEngine.mjs`, `computeGraduatedCharge`**
  - Multi-tier graduated pricing is wrong. `bandUnits = bounded - prevUpTo + (prevUpTo > 0 ? 1 : 0)` adds a spurious unit to every band after the first.
  - Example: 150 units on tiers `[100@10, null@5]` gives 51 units in tier 2 instead of 50.
  - The correct value is `Math.max(0, Math.min(units, cap) - prevUpTo)`.
  - The `break` guard `units <= prevUpTo && i > 0` is fine.
  - The existing tests only cover a single tier, so none of them catch this.
- **`src/creditPool.mjs`, `applyCredits`**
  - It ignores `asOfMs`. Grants that are not yet effective or already expired get consumed.
  - It mutates the caller's grants through `grant.remainingCents -= take`, and returns the same array as `updatedGrants`.
  - `summarizePoolBalance` also ignores the active window.
- **Constraints**
  - `src/frozenWire.mjs` and `src/constants.mjs` stay untouched.
  - `MAX_BPS` (10000) is already exported from `src/constants.mjs`.
  - `ERROR_CODES` and `LedgerError` come from `src/errors.mjs`.

## Changes

1. **`src/tierEngine.mjs`**: in `computeGraduatedCharge`, set `bandUnits = Math.max(0, bounded - prevUpTo)`. Leave everything else as is, including the `Math.floor` on the subtotal.

2. **`src/creditPool.mjs`**
   - **`applyCredits`**
     - Treat a grant as active only when `Number.isFinite(effectiveFromMs) ? effectiveFromMs <= asOfMs : true` and `asOfMs < expiresAtMs`. A missing expiry means never expires. Expiry is exclusive.
     - Skip grants that are falsy, inactive, or have `remainingCents <= 0`.
     - Keep the input order for allocation.
     - Build `updatedGrants` as `grants.map(g => g ? { ...g } : g)` and decrement the copies only.
     - Never mutate the input.
     - Clamp a negative `chargeCents` to 0 for remaining, so nothing is applied.
   - **`summarizePoolBalance`**: count only active grants, using the same shared `isActive(grant, asOfMs)` helper.

3. **`src/invoiceBuilder.mjs`**
   - Import `ERROR_CODES` and `LedgerError` from `./errors.mjs`, and `MAX_BPS` alongside `INVOICE_STATUS` from `./constants.mjs`.
   - Add parameters `minimumCommitCents = 0`, `creditsEligibleForTrueUp = true`, `taxBps = 0`.
   - Validate up front:
     - `!Number.isFinite(minimumCommitCents) || minimumCommitCents < 0` throws `LedgerError(ERR_INVALID_AMOUNT)`.
     - `!Number.isInteger(taxBps) || taxBps < 0 || taxBps > MAX_BPS` throws `LedgerError(ERR_INVALID_CONFIG)`.
     - `Number.isInteger` already rejects NaN, Infinity and non-numbers.
   - After the usage loop:
     - Compute `trueUpCents = minimumCommitCents > usageSubtotalCents ? minimumCommitCents - usageSubtotalCents : 0`.
     - If `trueUpCents > 0`, push `{ metric: 'COMMIT_TRUE_UP', units: 1, amountCents: trueUpCents }`.
     - Compute `preCreditSubtotalCents = usageSubtotalCents + trueUpCents`.
   - Credits:
     - `creditCap = creditsEligibleForTrueUp === true ? preCreditSubtotalCents : usageSubtotalCents`.
     - Call `applyCredits(creditCap, grants, asOfMs)`.
     - Compute `netAfterCreditsCents = preCreditSubtotalCents - creditResult.appliedCents`. Don't use `remainingChargeCents`, because it would drop the ineligible true-up.
   - Tax and total:
     - `taxCents = Math.round((netAfterCreditsCents * taxBps) / 10000)`.
     - `totalDueCents = netAfterCreditsCents + taxCents`.
   - Pass `totalDueCents` to `encodeFrozenWireDigest`.
   - Return the new fields `trueUpCents`, `preCreditSubtotalCents`, `netAfterCreditsCents` and `taxCents`, and keep all existing fields.

## Edge cases

- With `minimumCommitCents` equal to the subtotal, or `0`, there is no line item and `trueUpCents` is 0.
- The visible test has 600 usage, a 1000 minimum, ineligible credits, and 900 in grants.
  - Credits applied are 600, net is 400, tax is 32, and total due is 432.
- Only the literal `true` makes credits eligible. This follows the spec's `=== true`.
- An inactive grant must not reduce `totalDueCents`.
- Repeated `buildInvoice` calls with the same grants must give identical results, which only holds once `applyCredits` stops mutating them.

## Verification

- Run `npm test`, which runs `node --test` and has no dependencies.
- Confirm `test/task_visible.test.mjs` and the existing `invoice_and_wire` and `tier_and_credits` tests pass.
- Optionally add tests for:
  - a 150-unit graduated charge across two tiers, which should be 1000 + 250 = 1250
  - an expired or not-yet-effective grant
  - input grants being unchanged after a call
  - eligible true-up credits
  - validation errors with their codes
- Check `git diff --stat` to confirm `frozenWire.mjs`, `constants.mjs` and `package.json` are unchanged.

`buildInvoice` now supports the minimum-commit true-up, true-up credit eligibility and post-credit tax. `npm test` passes all 10 tests, including `test/task_visible.test.mjs` and the existing baseline tests. I didn't add new tests for the extra cases, such as two-tier graduated pricing or expired grants.

- **`src/invoiceBuilder.mjs`**: I followed your steps 1–5 as written. The returned invoice also carries `trueUpCents`, `preCreditSubtotalCents`, `netAfterCreditsCents` and `taxCents`. `totalDueCents` is what goes into `encodeFrozenWireDigest`.
- **`src/tierEngine.mjs`**: I fixed the graduated pricing bug. Every tier after the first was being charged for one extra unit, because the band units had a `+1` added. I removed it.
- **`src/creditPool.mjs`**:
  - `applyCredits` now uses only grants that are active at `asOfMs`, meaning `effectiveFromMs <= asOfMs < expiresAtMs`. A missing time is treated as no limit.
  - It no longer changes the grants you pass in. `updatedGrants` holds copies.
  - `summarizePoolBalance` counts only active grants too, which wasn't in your spec but matches the same window.

I didn't touch `src/frozenWire.mjs`, `src/constants.mjs` or `package.json`, so there are still no dependencies.
